text:
mika: Hey team — running the node quickstart and it stalls after npm start. Browser shows websocket connect then a 403. App logs: 'token not found in cache'. Using Node 18 on macOS, REDWOOD_API_KEY is set. Anyone seen this? :confused:

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-5189 for follow-up. Please paste logs and repro steps.

jordan: Which quickstart repo/version? And paste the terminal output around the 403.

mika: quickstart-node (github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-node). Terminal snippet:
```
> npm run start
Server listening on http://localhost:3000
[2026-03-22T12:01:02Z] INFO: connecting to api...
[2026-03-22T12:01:02Z] ERROR: request failed 403 Forbidden
Error: token not found in cache
    at refreshAuth (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/auth.js:112)
```

lee: That message means the SDK tried a cached service token, it didn't exist, then the refresh failed with 403. Two common causes: 1) Using a workspace-scoped key that needs the org header, 2) The org hasn't accepted billing/terms so first-call refresh is blocked.

mika: I thought REDWOOD_API_KEY was always enough locally. How can I check the org state?

sam: Open https://console.redwood.ai/orgs and look for a banner about billing/trial. If gated you'll see "First-call blocked: billing required". Invited users often need to accept terms.

mika: Confirmed the console shows "Accept billing/terms to enable API calls". So that was it. Is there a dev bypass?

jordan: For now either: 1) create a personal API key (Profile -> API keys) and set REDWOOD_API_KEY to that, or 2) run the CLI login flow: `npx @redwood/cli login` which creates a local dev token at ~/.redwood/token that the SDK will pick up. Both bypass the org-first-call refresh path.

mika: Tried CLI login — works, app returns 200 on the hello route. Thanks!

sam: I'll update DEVEX-5189 with a request to surface clearer SDK errors when a refresh is blocked (e.g., surface "billing/terms required" instead of generic 403).

jordan: I'll open a small quickstart PR: detect 403 during refresh and print a helpful message with the console link. That would've saved a few minutes.

mika: Attaching repro to the ticket now.
